messages:
Maya R: Quick follow-up from the runbook postmortem — we need a compact owner/timeline for the restore runbook stability items before next week's rehearsal.
Samir K: Agreed. Can we split into 3 buckets: routing rules, snapshot cadence, and rollback validation?
Ivy L: yep that's the right separation. I'll own routing rules (DNS failover + regional weights).
Jorge P: I'll take snapshot cadence (s3 lifecycle + retention checks).
Maya R: Perfect. For rollback validation we need an owner who can run the end-to-end test and sign off on expected latency regressions. @Samir K can you?
Samir K: I can, but only if someone helps with the traffic-shaping scripts. pinging @Ivy L for the load profile.
Ivy L: I can provide the profile and a short harness. Putting snippet here: ```bash
# sim load for eu-west
python simulate_traffic.py --region eu-west --rps 200 --duration 300
```
Maya R: Thanks. Let's set concrete deadlines: routing rules doc by Tue (48h), snapshot cadence audit by Thu, rollback test run and signoff next Monday. Sound ok?
Jorge P: Thu works for the audit. I'll post the current snapshot manifests to the shared drive and add a short checklist.
Samir K: Monday for the signoff is OK. I'll need a dry-run earlier — can we do a quick smoke on Friday?
Maya R: Yes — smoke Friday morning. Ops-bot: reminder scheduled for 2024-05-03 09:00 UTC "Dry-run: Restore smoke"
ops-bot: Reminder created and added to #incidents calendar.
Ivy L: One more thing — we keep seeing a recurring pattern where multi-region routing flips to backup region when KV cache warming fails. Propose adding a cache-warm preflight to the runbook (owner: Ivy).
Maya R: Good catch — add that as an explicit step. Also Samir, can you add a tolerant fallback variant to the routing policy so traffic ramps gradually?
Samir K: Yep — pairing with Ivy Friday for the script.
Jorge P: I'm going to add an actionable item to the remediation tracker: "Verify snapshot restore time under normal and degraded network" — ETA Thu.
Maya R: I'll consolidate all items into a single tracker doc and link the tickets. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-482 (will create subtasks).
Ivy L: Suggest we capture a quick puppet/terraform diff for the routing change and put it behind a canary rollout. Small canary first (10% region), then 50% after 30m, full after 2h.
Samir K: +1 on canary. Add me as reviewer for the terraform diff.
Maya R: Owners recap: routing - Ivy; snapshots - Jorge; rollback test & routing fallback - Samir. Deadlines: routing doc Tue, snapshot audit Thu, smoke Fri, signoff Mon. Game-day: schedule rehearsal Tues 2024-05-07 15:00 UTC.
Ivy L: I'll create the runbook PR and tag reviewers.
Jorge P: Uploading manifests now.
Samir K: I'll draft the rollback test plan and post steps under INFR-482.
Maya R: Thanks team. I'll send a short summary email to ENG-ONCALL and product ops. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when you see your item?
Ivy L: :thumbsup:
Jorge P: :thumbsup:
Samir K: :thumbsup:
Maya R: Closing thread for now — will reopen if any ETA slips.
